title: Missing or damaged items
text: If an item is missing or arrives damaged, report it within 48 hours. Open Orders, select the order, tap Help, and choose 'Report a problem'. Eligible items are refunded to your original payment method or Zapp wallet after a quick review.
questions: What should I do if something is missing from my order?
How can I report a damaged item from my shipment?
Is there a time limit to report missing items from my parcel?
Will I get a refund for items that didn't arrive or were damaged?
